content: .{@-यमकम्@} ‘a great {%Yamaka%}’, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} a stanza all the four lines of which have exactly the same words, though different in sense; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} see <ls>Ki. 15. 52</ls>, where विकाशमीयुर्जगतीशमार्गणाः has four different senses; <ab>cf.</ab> also बभौ मरुत्वान् विकृतः समुद्रः <ls>Bk. 10. 19</ls>.
